products.title: ColorPro VP2776T-4K Monitor
products.description: The ViewSonic ColorPro VP2776T-4K is a 27-inch 4K HDR monitor designed for professionals. It features a 16:9 IPS panel with 3840 x 2160 UHD resolution, providing crisp visuals and a wide 178° viewing angle. The monitor is Pantone validated and factory calibrated for high color accuracy (Delta <2), covering 98% of the DCI-P3 and 89% of the Adobe RGB color gamuts. It offers versatile connectivity with Thunderbolt 4, dual HDMI 2.1, and DisplayPort 1.4, including an integrated dock with a 2.5GbE Ethernet port and various USB ports. Additional features include VESA HDR400 certification, built-in 3W stereo speakers, and an ergonomic stand that supports height, tilt, swivel, and 90° rotation.

products.title: Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH LED Monitor
products.description: The Samsung ViewFinity S8 S80UH is a 27-inch 4K UHD LED monitor designed for detailed visuals and multitasking. It features a 3840 x 2160 resolution IPS panel with 350 cd/m² brightness, a 1000:1 static contrast ratio, and HDR10 support for enhanced color and contrast. The monitor includes versatile connectivity with USB-C (providing 90W charging and data transfer), LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort. products.title: Dell 27 Plus 4k USB-C Monitor
products.description: The Dell 27 Plus 4K USB-C Monitor (S2725QC) is a 27-inch LED monitor featuring a 4K UHD resolution (3840 x 2160) and a refresh rate of up to 120Hz.
